research_question: Can official-event presence combined with stock-price confirmation and PIT-safe global/sector/macro state improve exits of already-bought V3 positions without changing V3 entry selection?

data_contract.exit_execution_rule: a signal computed after decision-day close can execute only on the next symbol trading day

boundary.eligible_positions: positions actually bought in the frozen baseline account
boundary.candidate_only_positions: mechanical horizon only because no preregistered prediction exists

model.target: next-trading-day exit return minus frozen baseline-exit return for each baseline position-day
model.target_availability: training row joins only after the frozen baseline sell day is strictly before the current decision day
model.core_features: position path, holding age, rank and V3 entry price-volume features
model.full_features: core plus PIT global, SW L1, macro, official-event counts/categories and post-event stock-price confirmation
model.external_increment: full ridge prediction minus core ridge prediction

selection.one_standard_error_rule: among tuning-and-validation survivors choose the sparsest highest-threshold variant within one validation monthly-delta standard error of the best
selection.standout_gate: at least 10 percent relative return improvement, or one fewer negative month together with improved drawdown
